entries.name: Fast Draw
entries.rule_summary: Once per round, ready or stow one accessible one-handed weapon for 0 AP.

entries.name: Threat Focus
entries.rule_summary: Choose one visible threat you can track. Add d4 as a VAM die to the first appropriate defense against that threat before your next turn.

entries.name: Snap Shot
entries.rule_summary: After taking Aim, your next trained ranged attack this turn costs 0 AP instead of its normal AP cost.

entries.name: Control Hold
entries.rule_summary: On a successful Unarmed/Grappling attack with margin 4+, forgo damage to establish a Grapple or comparable close-control state.

entries.name: Overwatch
entries.rule_summary: Spend 1 AP while guarding a visible lane or approach. Until your next turn, your Reaction may make one eligible ranged attack against a qualifying target.

entries.name: Suppressive Fire
entries.rule_summary: Spend 2 AP with an appropriate automatic weapon. On success, inflict Suppressed instead of normal damage unless another rule explicitly allows both.

entries.name: Disarm Protocol
entries.rule_summary: Attempt a Disarm without dealing damage. On margin 8+, choose where the object lands within a plausible nearby space.

entries.name: Counter-Ambush
entries.rule_summary: When an ambush or surprise attack begins and you can communicate, linked allies add d4 as a VAM die to Initiative and may ready one accessible weapon for 0 AP before normal turns begin.

entries.name: Precision Interdiction
entries.rule_summary: When your Overwatch attack succeeds by margin 4+, choose normal damage or halt the target's current movement/advance if the fiction permits.

entries.name: Predictive Ballistics Matrix
entries.rule_summary: Against a recently observed target, qualifying attacks with the Mastered ranged Combat Skill include its Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Close-Combat Forecast
entries.rule_summary: Against a foe directly engaged or observed in close combat this round, qualifying rolls include the Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Crossfire Geometry
entries.rule_summary: Once per round when a linked ally attacks a target you can threaten, spend your Reaction to add d6 as a VAM die to that ally's attack or reposition a short distance before it resolves.

entries.name: Kill-Chain Interrupt
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, interrupt a visible enemy's attack or hostile maneuver with an eligible attack by spending your Reaction and committing 1 AP from your next turn.

entries.name: Combat Synthesis
entries.rule_summary: After legally using a Combat Skill Mastery Die, transfer the solution to one linked ally; that ally adds d6 as a VAM die to one immediately related tactical roll.
